blurb: Guests sail aboard two yachts: the historic 1935 ketch Lady Patty and the modern 44-foot Leopard catamaran Epiphany. Trips include public and private charters, with options for day sails, sunset cruises, and sailing lessons. The experience includes scenic views of the Chesapeake Bay, wildlife sightings, and opportunities to relax or participate in sailing.
